messages:
ravi_ops: Noticed a batch of invoices where allocation percentages sum to 0% after customers switched plans during the billing window. Seen on acct=9221 invoice=6723 and a few others.

lexi_billing: That's weird. Are the invoice lines empty or just allocations missing?

ravi_ops: Lines present in Stripe, but our NetSuite allocation records show zeros. Stripe webhook for invoice.finalized and invoice.updated arrived back-to-back; looks like our connector wrote a create with empty allocations then an update later, but NetSuite record didn't pick up the update.

sync-bot: netsuite-connector: processed events=24 failures=1 retried=1 run_id=2026-04-10T04:02Z

jonah_recon: Could be the connector's concurrency bug that drops line items when update payload arrives without expected metadata. I have a quick query to list affected invoices: `select invoice_id from ns_allocs where allocated_amount = 0 and created_at > '2026-04-09'`.

lexi_billing: We had a maintenance window last night where the connector was restarted and DLQ replays happened. Our DLQ uses standard SQS, not FIFO, so replay order may differ. That matches symptoms.

maria_fin: How big is the dollar impact? Need to know if we should hold collections or notify customers.

jonah_recon: Preliminary: 27 invoices affected, total misallocated amount ~ $18,450. Most are proration cases.

lexi_billing: Suggested short-term fix: when applying an update, merge line items by line_id instead of replacing entire allocations blob. Long-term: add revisions field and ignore out-of-order events where incoming.rev <= current.rev.

ravi_ops: I can deploy a hotfix to the connector to merge by line_id and add idempotency token check. Will push to canary.

lexi_billing: Backfill plan: `tools/billing_repair --since=2026-04-09 --reason=connector-replay --dry-run` produces a CSV of (invoice_id, delta_amount, action). Need finance sign-off before applying compensation JEs.

maria_fin: Approve dry-run. For repairs > $500 create manual JE and loop in accounting. Otherwise auto-apply.

ravi_ops: Canary deployed to staging. If no regressions in 30m I'll roll to prod and trigger dry-run.

sync-bot: billing-repair: dry-run complete rows=27 total_delta=18450 status=dry-run (link: https://internal/recon/1851234567)

jonah_recon: Dry-run CSV excerpt:
```
invoice,delta,reason
6723,420.00,missing_allocation_on_replay
6729,1200.00,missing_allocation_on_replay
6740,15.50,missing_allocation_on_replay
```

lexi_billing: After prod run we'll enable an alert: count(allocations=0) > 0 for 5m -> page on-call billing. Also file a ticket to migrate DLQ to FIFO for invoice events.

maria_fin: Thanks. Keep thread updated with final volume and JE amounts. Also please prepare a short customer-facing statement if we need to notify billing-impact customers.

ravi_ops: Will post back when run completes. :rocket:
